body.p: plurality of three-axis coils (103A, 103B, 103C,103D, 103E), each three-axis coil (103A, 103B,103C, 103D, 103E) being adapted to emit a magnetic field, the magnetic fields of the three-axis coilsbeing detectable by a set of optically pumpedmagnetometers during a biomagnetic imagingexamination (MEG, MCG);a step (E4) of self-referencing of the positionof the optically pumped magnetometers with respectto the three-axis coils (103A, 103B, 103C, 103D,103E);a step (E5) of examination by biomagneticimaging (MEG, MCG) for obtaining biomagnetic data(MEG data, MCG data);a step (E6) of examination by magneticresonance imaging for obtaining MRI data;a step (E7) of merging the biomagnetic data(MEG data, MCG data) with the MRI data by simple matching of common positions acquired precisely during the biomagnetic imaging examination stepand the MRI examination step.

br.br:
1. A device for improving the precision of a biomagnetic image of a patient, the device (10) comprising:a covering (101) adapted to be positioned on an anatomical part of the patient;
a plurality of markers (102, 102A, 102B, 102C,
102D, 102E) arranged on the covering (101), the markers (102, 102A, 102B, 102C, 102D, 102E) being adapted to create a contrast when obtaining an image of the patient produced by magnetic resonance imaging;at least five three-axis coils (103A, 103B,
103C, 103D, 103E), each three-axis coil being adapted to emit a magnetic field, the magnetic fields of the three-axis coils (103A, 103B, 103C,
103D, 103E) being detectable by a set of optically pumped magnetometers during an examination by biomagnetic imaging (MEG, MCG), the three-axis coils (103A, 103B, 103C, 103D, 103E) being arranged on the covering (101) so that, when the device (10) is positioned on the patient, each three-axis coil (103A, 103B, 103C, 103D, 103E) is located on a singular point of the patient; the three-axis coils (103A, 103B, 103C, 103D, 103E) and markers (102A, 102B, 102C, 102D, 102E) of the plurality of markers (102, 102A, 102B, 102C, 102D,
102E) are placed at the same location on the covering so that, when the covering (101) is positioned on the patient, singular points of the part of the patient are detectable by magnetic resonance imaging and by biomagnetic imaging (MEG, MCG), in which the device (10) comprises supports (104A, 104B, 104C, 104D, 104E), each support (104A, 104B, 104C, 104D, 104E) having a first
17 reception zone (1041) adapted to receive one of the markers (102A, 102B , 102C, 102D, 102E) and a second reception zone (1042) adapted to receive one of the three-axis coils (103A, 103B, 103C,
103D, 103E), the marker and the three-axis coil then being placed at the same location on the covering (101), in which the second reception zone (1042) comprises a protuberance (1043) adapted to be housed in an associated cavity of the three- axis coil (103A, 103B, 103C, 103D, 103E),
characterized in that the protuberance (1043) comprises a main body (10431) and a pin (10432) extending from the main body (10431), the protuberance (1043) having the role of an indexing device for positioning the three-axis coil (103A,
103B, 103C, 103D, 103E) in the support (104A,
104B, 104C, 104D, 104E).
2. The device as claimed in claim 1, in which the covering (101) is made of a flexible biocompatible silicone material.
3. The device as claimed in either of claims 1 and 2, in which the markers (102, 102A, 102B, 102C, 102D,
102E) comprise gadolinium and/or a plurality of superparamagnetic nanoparticles.
4. The device as claimed in any one of claims 1 to 3, in which each marker (102, 102A, 102B, 102C, 102D, 102E) has the shape of a pellet having a diameter of less than or equal to 6 mm.
5. The device as claimed in any one of claims 1 to 4, in which the device (10) is adapted to be positioned on a face (1) of the patient, or in which the device (10) is adapted to be positioned on a torso (2) of the patient.
